summary: Larsen Bay Airport serves the small Alutiiq community of Larsen Bay on the northwest coast of Kodiak Island, Alaska. As one of Alaska's fly-in communities with no road access to the outside world, the airport is a vital transportation and mail lifeline connecting residents to Kodiak and beyond. The facility primarily supports general aviation, charter flights, and critical medical evacuations in this remote, weather-prone coastal region.
